notes.title: Zerko is Out!
notes.content:
I'm excited to share that my new puzzle game, "ZERKO," is now available. 
For the first time, my game includes numbers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2862990/Zerko/

notes.title: Zerko & No.9 Announcement
notes.content:
I made two games! 

[b]"Zerko"[/b] - a Sudoku-esque puzzler will be launching on March 27th. 
[b]"No.9"[/b]- artsy experiment, launching on May 8th.

Priced 1,99$ each :) 

More info here: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2862990/Zerko]Zerko - Steam Page[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863090/No9/]No.9 - Steam Page[/url]

Your support means a lot to me! If you could add the games to your wishlist, that would be incredibly helpful. Thank you!
